en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing an equestrian statue of Kaiser Wilhelm I on a large pedestal adorned with several standing and seated figures. The monument stands in a formal urban square, in front of an ornate multi‑story historicist building. Several men in early 20th‑century clothing stand around the monument. Printed red text at the bottom identifies the location and subject, and a small printer's line appears along the lower edge.
